[[File:Edimmu icon.png|left]]
'''Edimmu''' are level 90 [[Slayer]] creatures found in the [[Edimmu resource dungeon]] in [[Prifddinas]], which requires 115 [[Dungeoneering]]. They can only be fought while on a Slayer assignment (unless using [[Slayer Wildcard]]s), and players will not receive an edimmu assignment unless they are able to enter the dungeon. [[Edimmu (Slayer assignment)|Edimmu Slayer assignment]] is assigned by [[Duradel]]/[[Lapalok]], [[Kuradal]], [[Morvran]], and [[Laniakea]]. [[Jacquelyn]], [[The Raptor]], and [[Vannaka]] may assign [[Ghosts (Slayer assignment)|Ghosts]] or [[Zombies (Slayer assignment)|Zombies]]. The Raptor and Laniakea may assign [[Undead (Slayer assignment)|Undead]], and Laniakea may assign [[Creatures of Daemonheim]]. All of these cluster tasks can be used to kill edimmu.

The original edimmu in the dungeon are likely to be human victims of [[Vicendithas]]'s [[crystal dragon]]. They would remain untouched for thousands of years until some of [[Meilyr Clan]]'s best explorers discovered the dungeon and fell victim to them. As a result, more edimmu spawned from their corpses, and Clan Meilyr erected a barrier to contain the edimmu, assigning a [[Meilyr Guard|single guard]] outside the barrier to ensure they would not escape.

They will attack with both magic and melee, and occasionally heal 25% of the damage they deal in combat. Their ashes can be collected in an [[infernal urn]]. When killing edimmu, it is possible for an [[edimmu (elite)|elite]] version to spawn (at least one spawn is guaranteed while on a Slayer assignment). This chance can be increased with the use of [[fellstalk incense stick]]s, tier 3 [[luck]], and building and upgrading Fort Forinthry's [[Guardhouse]].

Although considered to be a task-only monster, this is only partially true; edimmu can be killed in the [[Sunken Pyramid]] off-task via indirect damage, such as poison, dreadnips, familiars and reflect damage. Kills achieved this way still count towards the edimmu tracker, and can still spawn elite edimmu.

==Strategy==
Like their Dungeoneering counterparts, an edimmu's attack has a small chance of healing it, recovering 25% of the damage dealt to the player. As undead, they are susceptible to the effects of the [[salve amulet]] and its [[Salve amulet (e)|enchanted version]], the [[Undead Slayer (ability)|Undead Slayer]] [[ability]], and the [[Undead Slayer]] perk. As ghosts, they are susceptible to the effects of the [[ghost hunter equipment]].

The only melee weapons that work effectively against edimmu are [[slash weapons]]; all other melee weapons will have much lower accuracy, due to their 85 Defence and 30 melee affinity. Players can also opt to use ranged or magic, as edimmu are more susceptible to these attacks. This is also beneficial when fighting elite edimmu, as they don't have the slash weakness of their inferior brethren. The [[dragon scimitar]]'s special attack, Sever, increases accuracy against all targets when using slash weapons for one minute and can come in handy against elite edimmu if melee is chosen. Edimmu can be bunched up near the entry barrier by exiting and entering it, and easily taken down in mass with area of effect attacks such as [[halberds|halberd type weapons]] or [[mechanised chinchompas]]. As edimmu use relatively weak attacks, many can be tanked at once using [[magic tank armour]] in conjunction with [[Animate Dead]] and [[Soul Split]]. As edimmu are fought while on a slayer task, frequent use of the empowered [[Tuska's Wrath]] is recommended.

Edimmu are aggressive but fairly spread apart; a [[dwarf multicannon]] or [[oldak coil]] along with [[aggression potion]]s can help group them, but players should be careful as it is very easy to get piled from numerous edimmu attacking at once. [[Edimmu (elite)|Elite edimmu]] are much more dangerous than their normal counterparts, as they attack faster and their maximum hit is three times higher. [[Protect from Magic]] or [[Deflect Magic]] can be used to mitigate their damage, although it is fairly safe to use Soul Split when only a few of them are attacking at once. [[Dominion mines]] can also be used against elite edimmu to take them down quicker.

Edimmu are not as aggressive compared to other monsters, but will attack adjacent players even if they are fighting another edimmu. Edimmu placed in the Sunken Pyramid are not aggressive.
